title: Narrow over-exported package symbols that have no external consumer
goal: Four symbols are exported but only used inside their own package, which makes pkg/ look like it offers capabilities it does not: common.IsI18nMessageKey is called only by common.ResolveErrorMessageKey, rbacbind.InsertRoleMenu and InsertUserRole are called only by the sibling EnsureRoleMenu and EnsureUserRole, contracts.ProtectedGroupWithRedis is called only by sibling ProtectedGroup, and permission_handler.permissionServiceErrorCode is a one-line pass-through to common.CodeForError with a single call site. A fifth item, database.RunAutoMigrate, has no caller at all and is only kept in case a downstream wanted a GORM AutoMigrate escape hatch that the project does not otherwise use. This wave either makes them private, deletes the pass-through, or records the decision to keep the public name, so the exported surface matches the real contract.
findings: RC-004 (P3): common.IsI18nMessageKey (backend/pkg/common/error.go:117) is referenced only at error.go:129 by ResolveErrorMessageKey; pkg/common/http/response.go has an independent equivalent.

RC-007 (P3): rbacbind.InsertRoleMenu (backend/pkg/rbacbind/rbacbind.go:49) and InsertUserRole (:55) are called only by EnsureRoleMenu (:100) and EnsureUserRole (:116) in the same file; the batch variants are the real external API.

RC-008 (P3): contracts.ProtectedGroupWithRedis (backend/pkg/contracts/route_groups.go:16) is called only by ProtectedGroup (:13); the overlay uses ProtectedGroup and DataScopedGroup, not this constructor. Recommendation is keep, recorded rather than changed.
RC-029 (P3): permission_handler.go:20-27 permissionServiceErrorCode has a body of exactly `return common.CodeForError(err)`; the wrapper adds no mapping.
RC-006 (P3): backend/pkg/database/migrate.go:442-460 RunAutoMigrate has zero callers in the repo and in the overlay; the project migrates with golang-migrate SQL files.

in: Rename common.IsI18nMessageKey to unexported isI18nMessageKey and update its single internal call
Rename rbacbind.InsertRoleMenu and InsertUserRole to unexported insertRoleMenu and insertUserRole
Delete permissionServiceErrorCode and call common.CodeForError directly at its single site
Decide and record whether database.RunAutoMigrate is deleted or kept as a documented public escape hatch; delete only if the maintainer confirms no downstream use
Record the decision to keep contracts.ProtectedGroupWithRedis exported
out: Deleting ProtectedGroup or DataScopedGroup, which the overlay uses
Changing error-code behaviour: CodeForError stays the single mapping
Removing the private duplicate in pkg/common/http/response.go, which belongs to a later wave

implementationNotes: Unexporting is a compile-time probe: if anything outside the package still calls the symbol the build fails, which is exactly the signal wanted.

RunAutoMigrate is the only item in this wave that could be a deliberate public surface for downstream. Keep it unless the maintainer explicitly says otherwise; the line saving is 19 lines and not worth an unapproved contract change.
Do not merge the pkg/common and pkg/common/http message-key logic here; that is RC-019 in the S2 wave and needs its own equivalence tests.

executionRoles.implementerPosture: Make the symbols private one at a time so the compiler reports any hidden consumer; leave the two deferred files untouched.
reviewerPosture: Confirm no exported symbol lost an external consumer.
Confirm permission error responses still carry common.CodeForError's mapping.
Confirm route_groups.go and migrate.go are unchanged unless the maintainer explicitly approved.
